title: Connection-string password: benign encoded value controls
summary: 1 input holding benign encoded or hashed values of the same general shape.
rationale: Hashes, checksums and encoded text share alphabets and lengths with credentials. Reporting them is a false alarm that grows with repository size.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Public identifier or benign encoding constructed to contain no credential: silence follows from construction.
